How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Orders normally ship within 1 to 2 business days after being placed.
Tracking details are generated when the order is processed, and the status updates once the delivery carrier picks up the package in the afternoon. Standard delivery typically takes between 1 to 5 business days depending on your location.
